items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Paul Lominguez was playing the violin.

ctx.x: question. Anything else, Ralph? Think of anywhere else you played? Any musicians? Well, anywhere else I played? Yeah. In places like that. I don't too well. Like on the lake. You played a whole lot of campsite on the lake, I know. Oh, well I played a whole lot of little

single job with different guys. Yeah, yeah. Well, who? Where? Oh, oh. Hundreds of them, I guess. I played with a whole lot of people. I was telling you, I was telling you of the bands that I played with. But besides that, oh, I played a whole lot of little combinations. Five and six combinations. You know that. I played with you a lot of times. I know that. I played with you. With a combination. Did you ever play with a violin in the band? Yeah. I used to play with the cellar. But the cellar that died. He was…
How many pieces was in the band? How many pieces?
